scenario: 按供应商 + 未上架状态搜索商品 — happy path
input: 帮我列出供应商是 Nike 的所有未上架商品

semantic_rubric: --vendor Nike taken verbatim (vendor is an exact-match filter per --help), not put into --keyword
未上架 mapped to --published unpublished (documented values: published, unpublished, any)
any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r

notes: +search --vendor is exact match; --keyword filters by product title only.

scenario: English keyword search with field projection
input: Find products with hoodie in the title and show me just their ids and titles

semantic_rubric: --keyword hoodie (keyword filters by product title per --help)
projection done with --fields id,title (this shortcut supports --fields) or an equivalent --jq over .data
does not add published/vendor filters the user never mentioned

notes: products +search is one of the few shortcuts with --fields; both --fields and --jq projections are acceptable, --fields preferred.

scenario: 统计已上架商品数 — +count with published filter
input: 店里现在一共有多少已上架的商品？

semantic_rubric: uses products +count, not +search plus manual counting
extracts the number from .data (never fabricates a count)
